subject: Packaging options: mixing Pro+ seats with Standard + downgrade path
messages:
From: Emily Shaw <emily.shaw@acmeanalytics.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@acmeanalytics.com>
Date: Wed, 3 Dec 2025 15:12:00 -0800
Subject: Packaging options for upcoming renewal

Hi Jordan,

Thanks for the call earlier. Our renewal is coming up and the product team is debating between moving everyone to Pro+ or keeping a mixed setup (Pro+ for 50 seats, Standard for the rest). A few specific questions we need answered before we finalize an internal recommendation: 

- Can we mix seat tiers within the same org under one contract and have seat-level feature access?
- If we need to step down later (e.g., move seats from Pro+ back to Standard), what is the downgrade policy and timeline? Any pro-rated refunds?
- Do you offer seat-bundle discounts for mixed-tier commits (e.g., 50 Pro+ + 150 Standard)?
- What features are exclusive to Pro+ that would affect our decision (longer context, dedicated throughput, priority support)?

Could you share a short matrix or proposal that lists pricing bands and the downgrade/upgrade rules? Procurement also asked about any minimum commitment term and billing cadence.

Appreciate the help — looking to present a recommendation by next week.

Best,
Emily
Emily Shaw
Director of Data Products
Acme Analytics

Attachment: none (requested pricing matrix)

From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
To: Emily Shaw <emily.shaw@acmeanalytics.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@acmeanalytics.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 3 Dec 2025 16:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Packaging options for upcoming renewal

Hi Emily — thanks for the clear list. Short answers up top, then details and an attached matrix: 

- Yes, you can mix seat tiers under a single contract and manage feature access at the seat level. We support role-based feature flags so Pro+ features can be enabled per user.
- Downgrade path: seats can be stepped down at the next billing cycle after a 30-day notice. There are no retroactive refunds for past usage; reductions apply going forward. We can discuss a partial credit for unused pre-paid committed seats on a case-by-case basis for multi-year contracts.
- Mixed-tier discounts: we have a pricing ladder for blended commitments. For the mix you described (50 Pro+ / 150 Standard), typical range is 10–18% off list depending on term (12 vs 24 months) and onboarding credits.
- Pro+ exclusives: higher concurrency/throughput SLOs, longer context windows (up to 64k), priority routing and 24x7 priority support, and advanced optimizer recommendations.

I'm attaching a short pricing matrix to illustrate list vs blended pricing and the step-down mechanics. Highlights from the matrix:

- Upgrade (Standard -> Pro+): immediate (prorated charge to next invoice).
- Downgrade (Pro+ -> Standard): requires 30-day notice; pricing effective next billing cycle.
- Seat reassignments: allowed anytime; feature access toggles at user-level.

If you'd like, we can set a short trial for a subset of Pro+ seats for 30 days so your team can validate performance before committing.

Next steps: I can produce a formal proposal that includes a blended discounted band and standard terms. If procurement has PO templates or terms they need, send them over and we’ll align.

Regards,

Jordan Blake
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jordan_blake@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0198

Attachment: ProPlus-pricing-matrix.xlsx

From: Procurement Team <procurement@acmeanalytics.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Emily Shaw <emily.shaw@acmeanalytics.com>
Date: Thu, 4 Dec 2025 09:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Packaging options for upcoming renewal

Jordan / Emily,

Thanks for the overview. A couple of procurement-specific items: 

- We need to confirm that mixed-tier billing can be consolidated into a single monthly invoice with line items per tier.
- Standard PO process: 30 days net after delivery, vendor W9 on file, and standard Redwood Master Services Agreement (MSA) review.
- For the blended discount, can you confirm the discount band if we commit to a 12-month term vs 24-month term? Also note that Acme requires a clause around data handling for analytics environments — SOC 2 evidence requested.

Please send the proposal with billing terms and SOC 2 link.

--
Acme Procurement
procurement@acmeanalytics.com

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 4 Dec 2025 11:42:00 -0800
Subject: RE: Packaging options for upcoming renewal

Jordan — quick internal note before you finalize the proposal for Acme: 

- Recommended commercial: allow blended discount range 12% (12mo) / 16% (24mo) for the 50 Pro+ / 150 Standard mix. We can flex to 18% if Acme agrees to a 24-month committed spend + onboarding professional services buy-in.
- Approve offering a 30-day Pro+ pilot for up to 10 seats at no additional cost (we'll absorb PS hours up to 8).
- Standard downgrade: document the 30-day notice and no retroactive refunds. If they request a mid-term reduction on a pre-paid multi-year deal, escalate to finance for possible partial credit.

Karthik: please confirm there are no technical blockers for seat-level feature flags and the pilot.

Thanks — Laura
VP, Sales Operations | Redwood Inference

From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
To: Emily Shaw <emily.shaw@acmeanalytics.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@acmeanalytics.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 4 Dec 2025 18:23:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Packaging options: mixing Pro+ seats with Standard + downgrade path

Emily — attaching the formal proposal with blended pricing and the pilot included. Key callouts in the proposal:

- Blended pricing: 12% off list for 12-month term; 16% off list for 24-month term. Tiered escalation to 18% with PS commitment (details in PDF).
- Billing: single consolidated invoice, line items per tier.
- Downgrade policy: 30-day notice, effective next billing cycle; no retroactive refunds. Escalation to finance for exceptional credit requests.
- Pilot: 10 Pro+ seats for 30 days with up to 8 hours of onboarding PS.
- SOC 2 and compliance evidence: https://redwood.internal/soc2/report (redacted link; full artifacts shared via secure upload upon NDA).

Please review and let me know if procurement needs changes to invoice cadence or PO language — we can incorporate standard PO terms. If this looks good, I'll send a DocuSign link for signature and the invoice schedule. Proposal attached and valid for 14 days.

Best,
Jordan

Attachment: Redwood-Proposal-ACME-20251204.pdf
DocuSign: https://docusign.com/example/ACME-2025-05 (sample link)
